WHO WINS WHEN A
BUSINESS IS BOUGHT?

caption:
Your town. Their exit plan?

PE Under Scrutiny will document private-equity ownership, transactions and reported outcomes for workers, customers and competition.

Case reports will identify companies, dates, records and sources. Direct quotations will be attributed. Allegations, settlements, research associations and court findings will be labeled separately. Ownership timelines will distinguish who owned a business at the time of an event from former investors.

Next: named cases and the records behind them.

#PrivateEquity #WorkersRights #ConsumerRights #Competition

voiceover_optional.text: Who wins when a business in your town gets bought?
Investors, customers, and workers can have different priorities.
We ask who owns it, how the deal was funded, and what changed.
A buyout alone is not a verdict. We check the evidence.
What should we investigate first? Follow PE Under Scrutiny.
